note.value:
Combat: The Hellhammer gun can only fire 3 times.
Range: The Hellhammer uses the 12" bolt template.
Close range is 0" to 6" with a -2 Save Modifier.
Long range is 6" to 12" with a -1 Save Modifier.
Damage: The Hellhammer cannon does 2 damage per hit, this might cause a Critical Hit.
Misfires: Attack rolls of 1 cause a Misfire, roll on the Critical Hit table.
Recoil: After firing, move Hellhammer 3" back. If it collides with another ship, each ship takes a random low area hit.
Reloading: It takes 2 turns to reload the Hellhammer's cannon. Slash mark ammo when firing, X 1st turn reloading, Asterick on 2nd turn when fully reloaded.
Boarding Actions: +2 CC modifier to the fore.
